# Interactive Lab {.unnumbered}

Estimate the models in these notes using Python in your browser. Select an empirical exercise, change its assumptions, and inspect the resulting estimates and diagnostics. Computation begins only when you run a specification; the first run downloads the required scientific packages.

The narrative-shock exercises use the Romer–Romer series extended by Wieland and Yang [@RomerRomer2004; @WielandYang2020]. Their quarterly specifications are adaptations, not exact replications.

